MAPP 02.02.02 IV.C and SAM 02.D.08 4.3: 'A leave of absence extends the probationary period of employment' refers to the employment probation of FMLA-ineligible employees under the parental-leave policy; not coded as a tenure clock (the tenure-clock rules are c11 and c13).

Birth parent chain: FMLA 12 workweeks from the birth, with accrued sick leave (own balance) used concurrently -> sick leave pool (discretionary, catastrophic only, up to 90 days) or short-term disability insurance (in lieu of the pool) -> extended-illness Leave without Pay up to 12 months (discretionary) -> part-time work (discretionary); extended sick leave (discretionary, employer) after sick leave; teaching relief (one semester, c9 or c10 in lieu of each other) also available, separate from FMLA, no order stated.

Non-birth parent chain: FMLA 12 workweeks (spouses both at UH share 12 weeks for the birth) with sick leave usable only to care for an ill mother or child, concurrent; teaching relief (one semester, as primary or co-equal caregiver) also available, no order stated.
